item_name: Rothco G.I. Style Stainless Steel Canteen Cup
item_short_desc: Elevate your outdoor experience with Rothco’s G.I. Style Stainless Steel Canteen Cup. Boasting a substantial 24oz. capacity, this versatile canteen cup seamlessly fits under all one-quart plastic canteens. The butterfly handle adds functionality, extending out 2 3/4" with a 3 1/8” hand opening for a secure grip. Crafted with precision, the G.I. Canteen Cup measures top dimensions of 5 1/4” x 3 1/4”, bottom dimensions of 4 1/2” x 2 7/8”, and a height of 3 3/4”.
